name: Tymon's GAN12 M MagLev UV 3x3
description: Tymon's GAN12 M MagLev 3x3 is a smooth, fast and controllable magnetic 3x3. This puzzle is lubed with a balanced mixture of Angstrom Gravitas, Angstrom Dignitas, and DNM-37 on the pieces. Combined with moderately strong MagLev tensions, a light compression setting, and medium-strength magnets, this puzzle has excellent control and speed.
features: Piece Lubes: Angstrom Gravitas, Angstrom Dignitas, DNM-37
